items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 33:1
items.html:
(to the question) Blood that turns into milk
The first phase of the waste, mentioned above in answer 31, which are the phases of Hod, Yesod, and Malchut within it that were not clarified at the time of pregnancy, do not come out outside with the birth, but rather they ascend to HGT and are turned there into milk. (Part 1, Page 137, Item 32; Part 1, Page 140, Item 44; Part 1, Page 142, Item 51). See below, in answer 34.
